notes: Irregular board shapes (rectangles plus a 20x20 shape editor with cross/ring/L/U presets and JSON import/export); custom sound themes, where each cue can use a built-in tone or your own audio file; the intro dialog is now collapsible; settings renamed to More
notes_zh: 新增异型棋盘（长方形与自定义不规则形状：20×20 形状编辑器、十字/口字/L/U 预设、可导入导出）、新增自定义音效主题（四个音效位可各选内置音色或传入音频）、引导弹窗改为可折叠、设置页更名「更多」
